what_this_is: The names a named refuser is called by in somebody else's headline, so that a check can see the route rather than only the polling. Diacritics are folded before matching, so 'cistoca' written here matches 'čistoća' as a Serbian newspaper spells it. This list is used ONLY to observe and to count. Nothing here is used to suppress, filter or remove a third party's publication: a refusal is a refusal to be our source, not a censorship of the world.

not_watched_and_why.politika: too common a word in Serbian ('policy', 'politics') to match a headline reliably; S105 is watched through 'nedeljnik' instead
not_watched_and_why.vreme: the same - 'vreme' is 'weather' and 'time', and this record is full of both
not_watched_and_why.zoomer: matched only as part of the S104 group through 'insajder' and 'ekapija'
